title: Create Hero Component with Tailwind CSS
description: Develop a reusable, accessible Hero section component for the landing page using React and Tailwind CSS, following the design system and best practices.
details:
- Create a new file at `components/landing/Hero.tsx`. - Implement the Hero component as a React Server Component. - Use semantic HTML elements:

for the sub-headline. - Style the component using Tailwind CSS utility classes, ensuring mobile-first responsiveness and adherence to the project's color palette, typography, and spacing as defined in `tailwind.config.js`. - Ensure all text has sufficient color contrast and the component is keyboard accessible. - Optionally, include a background illustration or image, optimized for web performance if used.
test_strategy:
- Render the component in isolation (e.g., Storybook or local test page) and verify:
  - Headline, sub-headline, and CTA button are present and visually correct.
  - Component is accessible via keyboard navigation and screen readers (using axe or Lighthouse).
  - Color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
  - Responsive layout adapts correctly from mobile to desktop viewports.

title: Integrate shadcn/ui Button for CTA
description: Use the existing shadcn/ui Button component for the Hero section's primary Call-to-Action, linking to the sign-up page.
details:
- Import the Button component from `components/ui/button.tsx`.
- Place the Button prominently within the Hero component, styled according to the design system.
- Set the Button's `asChild` or `href` prop (as appropriate) to link to `/sign-up`.
- Optionally, add an icon from lucide-react if it enhances clarity or visual appeal.
- Ensure the Button is accessible and has a descriptive label for screen readers.
test_strategy:
- Verify the Button renders correctly and matches the design system.
- Confirm the Button navigates to `/sign-up` when clicked.
- Check accessibility: Button is focusable and has an accessible name.
- Optionally, test with screen readers for correct announcement.

title: Integrate Hero Component into Landing Page
description: Render the new Hero component at the top of the main landing page (`app/page.tsx`).
details:
- Import the Hero component into `app/page.tsx`.
- Place the <Hero /> component at the top of the page, replacing any placeholder or existing hero content.
- Ensure the landing page layout remains consistent and the Hero section is visually prominent.
- Confirm that the integration does not break other landing page sections or routing.
test_strategy:
- Load the landing page in a browser and verify the Hero section appears as the first visible content.
- Confirm that navigation and layout for other sections remain unaffected.
- Test across multiple viewport sizes to ensure correct placement and responsiveness.

title: Validate Responsiveness and Accessibility
description: Test the Hero section across devices and ensure accessibility compliance.
details:
- Use browser dev tools and/or Storybook to test the Hero section at various breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop).
- Validate color contrast, keyboard navigation, and ARIA roles/labels.
- Run automated accessibility checks (axe, Lighthouse) and address any issues.
- Confirm that the CTA remains prominent and usable on all devices.
test_strategy:
- Manual and automated accessibility testing (axe, Lighthouse).
- Visual regression testing across breakpoints.
- Keyboard-only navigation test.
- Confirm all text is readable and interactive elements are usable on all devices.
